read.en: Rockwell Automation fell 4.4% on Nov 16 to $384.90, trading $383.72–394.69. It is below the 5-day ($399.0), 10-day ($403.1), 30-day ($423.7), 100-day ($439.8) and 200-day ($426.4), all falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5, below zero, histogram widening slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($434.81), and RSI is 36.5.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月16日下跌 4.4%，收于 $384.90，盘中区间 $383.72–394.69。股价位于 5 日（$399.0）、10 日（$403.1）、30 日（$423.7）、100 日（$439.8）和 200 日均线（$426.4）下方，均在下行。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图小幅放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$434.81），RSI 为 36.5。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports ($385.5–401.8), now resistance; the $383.72 low held the Nov 9 low ($383.13). Resistance is $388.4–394.7, then $397.2–403.1 (Nov 10 close, Nov 13 low, 5 and 10-day) and $406.9–412.7. Support is $383.1–383.7, then $375.9–378.3 (Nov 6 close, Nov 5 low) and $370.7 (Nov 6 low). A close above $394.7 would target $397–403; below $383.1, $376–378.
